style.vernacular: Hilly former colonial coal-mining capital on the Udi escarpment. The Government Reserved Area keeps Georgian-style colonial houses on narrow winding roads; the rest of the city is 1-3 storey cream, white and ochre painted-render houses and shops with rust-red or grey corrugated and long-span metal roofs, with 5-10 storey bank and office blocks along Okpara Avenue and bare red laterite earth verges under mango, neem and palm trees.
style.ornament: Colonial-Georgian veranda posts and hip roofs in the Government Reserved Area; modern breeze-block screens and concrete sun-breakers on public buildings; carved-wood gates and painted wall murals on Igbo compounds; church and bank signage as blank coloured boards.
